guides.title: Webcam Supervisor · prompts
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Manage reaction profiles
steps.body: In Prompts, read the Status and Active Reaction Profile. Use Add Profile, Rename Profile or Delete Profile to manage records. Select a profile and set Speaking style. Confirm Active Reaction Profile reflects the one you intend to use before adding rules.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Build rules for a profile
steps.body: Under Reaction Rules, use Add Rule and set Reaction rule, Enabled, Action, Strictness, Emotion override, Repeat mode and Nth match interval. Remove Rule deletes one. Enable rules deliberately, since a broad rule can fire often and surprise you during a session.

steps.title: Review the advanced prompt template
steps.body: In Advanced, read Advanced Prompt Rules as the template shaping how rules become a prompt. Restore recommended prompt returns it to the supplied baseline. Review Prompt Preview shows the result; use it before making further edits, so you can see the effect of the template.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Preview before relying on the template
steps.body: Choose Review Prompt Preview and read the generated text. Confirm the selected profile, rules and template together produce the behavior you expect. If the preview looks wrong, change the rule or template rather than assuming the webcam cue will be interpreted differently.
